notes:
Key account — large EU bank subsidiary evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for customer-facing chat + internal document search. Primary ask: full SIG/CAIQ + vendor risk intake packet. Procurement and InfoSec are heavy: require customer-managed KMS (HSM integration), audit logging with 7-year retention, and strict EU data residency (no US egress). 

Security snippets from calls:

- 'Can you map which controls are in Redwood's control plane vs our VPC?' — Procurement lead

Current ask list (top): SIG/CAIQ completed, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence, architecture diagram showing private control plane endpoints, KMS API contract (rotate/revoke), sample audit logs with schema, retention config, and legal addendum for data residency. 

POC scope: 2-week pilot in Frankfurt region, 4k concurrent chats/day (~120 req/s peak), embeddings index of 50M vectors, latency SLO 150ms p95 for short chats. Cost sensitivity: medium-high; looking to compare Dedicated reserved pricing vs Private fixed license. 

Notes on integration: prefer SAML SSO (Okta), SCIM for provisioning, and support for HSM-backed CMKs via AWS CloudHSM or customer HSM in VPC. Want explicit network IP allowlists for control-plane callbacks and cert pinning guidance. 

Procurement timeline: security intake completed -> legal review -> SOC attestation -> contract signed. Target signing: May 2026.
